```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(DBI)
library(RSQLite)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)
```

## Make SQL DB

```{r}


# ==========================================================
# 1. Set folder containing CSVs
# ==========================================================
csv_folder <- "~/Desktop/GRIT/Kibera/csv4db"    # <— change if necessary

csv_files <- list.files(csv_folder,
                        pattern = "\\.csv$",
                        full.names = TRUE)


# ==========================================================
# 2. Create SQLite database
# ==========================================================
db_path <- file.path(csv_folder, "kibera_survey.sqlite")
con <- dbConnect(SQLite(), db_path)
dbExecute(con, "PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;")

# ==========================================================
# 3. Fix x1_4 date formatting
# ==========================================================
fix_dates <- function(df) {

    if ("x1_4" %in% names(df)) {

        df$x1_4 <- as.character(df$x1_4)

        df$x1_4 <- case_when(
            # full ISO date already valid
            grepl("^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$", df$x1_4) ~ df$x1_4,

            # 5-digit corrupted year-month (20165 → 2016-05-01)
            grepl("^\\d{5}$", df$x1_4) ~ paste0(substr(df$x1_4, 1, 4),
                                                "-0",
                                                substr(df$x1_4, 5, 5),
                                                "-01"),

            # 4-digit year → set to Jan 1
            grepl("^\\d{4}$", df$x1_4) ~ paste0(df$x1_4, "-01-01"),

            # invalid → NA
            TRUE ~ NA_character_
        )
    }

    df
}

# ==========================================================
# 4. Read + clean CSV files
# ==========================================================
read_clean_csv <- function(file) {
    df <- read_csv(file, show_col_types = FALSE)

    # clean column names
    names(df) <- names(df) |>
        str_replace_all("\\.", "_") |>
        str_replace_all("\"", "") |>
        str_trim()

    # fix date column
    df <- fix_dates(df)

    if (!"x1_2" %in% names(df)) {
        stop(paste("ERROR:", basename(file), "is missing x1.2 / x1_2"))
    }

    df
}

tables <- map(csv_files, read_clean_csv)
names(tables) <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(csv_files))

# ==========================================================
# 5. Identify master table (most participants)
# ==========================================================
unique_counts <- sapply(tables, function(x) length(unique(x$x1_2)))
master_name <- names(which.max(unique_counts))
master_df <- tables[[master_name]]

cat("✅ Master table selected:", master_name, "\n")

# ==========================================================
# 6. Assign SQL types per your rule
# ==========================================================
assign_type <- function(colname) {

    # TEXT exceptions
    if (grepl("_TEXT$", colname) && colname != "x3_1_1_TEXT")
        return("TEXT")

    if (colname == "PHQ9Level")
        return("TEXT")

    # DATE exception
    if (colname == "x1_4")
        return("DATE")

    # AGE variable (in *_TEXT name but numeric)
    if (colname == "x3_1_1_TEXT")
        return("INTEGER")

    # everything else is integer-coded
    return("INTEGER")
}

# ==========================================================
# 7. Build SQL column definitions
# ==========================================================
make_col_defs <- function(df) {

    sql_types <- map_chr(names(df), assign_type)

    col_defs <- paste(
        paste0(names(df), " ", sql_types),
        collapse = ", "
    )

    return(col_defs)
}

# ==========================================================
# 8. Create master table with PRIMARY KEY
# ==========================================================
master_defs <- make_col_defs(master_df)

create_master_sql <- paste0("
    CREATE TABLE master (
        ", master_defs, ",
        PRIMARY KEY(x1_2)
    );
")

dbExecute(con, "DROP TABLE IF EXISTS master;")
dbExecute(con, create_master_sql)
dbWriteTable(con, "master", master_df, append = TRUE)

# ==========================================================
# 9. Create other module tables with FOREIGN KEY(x1_2)
# ==========================================================
for (nm in names(tables)) {

    if (nm == master_name) next

    df <- tables[[nm]]
    sql_name <- nm

    col_defs <- make_col_defs(df)

    create_table_sql <- paste0("
        CREATE TABLE ", sql_name, " (
            ", col_defs, ",
            FOREIGN KEY(x1_2) REFERENCES master(x1_2)
        );
    ")

    dbExecute(con, paste0("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ", sql_name, ";"))
    dbExecute(con, create_table_sql)
    dbWriteTable(con, sql_name, df, append = TRUE)
}

dbDisconnect(con)

cat("\n✅ SUCCESS! All CSVs imported with correct DATA TYPES + CLEAN DATES →\n", db_path, "\n")


```
